results.title: Invofox's AI parses 1,100-page mortgage file with 100% accuracy | Alberto Gimeno posted on the topic | LinkedIn
results.content:
We’re freaks. Freaks who are obsessed with document parsing. Last week, I gave an old 1,100-page mortgage file to our system. It parsed 1,100 pages of dense mortgage data: rate tables, bank statements, payment schedules, and signature pages into perfectly structured JSON schemas with 100% accuracy. Then I gave the same file to five competitors, some have raised $50M+, others have been building for 20 years. Not one of them got it right. Tables broke. Values vanished. Reading order collapsed. That’s the part most people don’t realize: The hardest thing about making AI agents work isn’t the model, it’s the context. Non-hallucinated values. Correct reading order. Structural consistency. These are the things that actually make your document knowledge base usable with LLMs. Document parsing [...] Like Reply  1 Reaction   2 Reactions

results.content:
I’m super grateful for our team at Invofox. You can feel the difference between high-agency and low-agency people immediately: it shows up in every conversation, every problem, every unexpected fire. High-agency looks like: • taking ownership instead of waiting for clarity • moving even when the path isn’t obvious • figuring things out without needing permission • being okay with temporary misunderstanding • fixing what’s broken instead of complaining that it’s broken Low-agency looks like: • waiting for instructions • avoiding action until there’s zero risk • worrying about what people will think • letting fear of mistakes freeze progress One mindset compounds.The other stalls everything around it. And the reason I appreciate our team so much is simple: they consistently choose the [...] our team so much is simple: they consistently choose the high-agency path, especially when it’s uncomfortable. Nothing in AI, infrastructure, or document systems is linear. Everything breaks, edge cases appear out of nowhere, and the real world refuses to behave like the demo. A low-agency team can’t survive that. A high-agency team thrives in it. That’s why I value ours so much. Thank you for having faith in us, it’s the reason we get to build at this level.
